The future description for reviewers could be approximately:

Guided by unexplained visions, the protagonist reaches an isolated region where ancient ruins have begun disturbing the surrounding land. What initially appears to be the awakening of a dangerous guardian gradually reveals traces of deliberate interference. By exploring the environment, combining the abilities of different characters and confronting the guardian protecting the ruins, the player discovers that the local crisis is only one fragment of a much larger mystery.
The Vertical Slice narrative works if, after playing, at least:

about what happened before their arrival.
The narrative needs revision if testers respond:
"I don't know why I was fighting."
"I thought Zalenquea was just a monster."
"I didn't understand what changed after the Elite."
"They explained too many things to me."
"I didn't understand anything, but there were names everywhere."
That last one is the classic scent of overloaded lore.
